items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Oh and then I also work with Jimmy Sturr who has a big band, he has 14, or I think he has 15 Grammys now.

ctx.x: What do you think of — here’s a big question — but what do you think of the music scene today? You don’t seem to have a lack of work. Right? You said before that work for you is not a problem.

No problem at all. I have no problem. And like January is supposed to be the slowest month for musicians. And I’ve been turning jobs down. And I presume Bucky is too and other musicians. And there are some that say, “Gee I only have two gigs this month” or three or four or whatever. I have too many. I’ve been turning some down. Because I guess a lot of it has to do with what you were asking me, how do I go from one venue to another, like if I have to go with a rock band, I’ll play with a rock band one night. The…
